title: A3.1 token signed claims
$comment: Structural residue of the auth.token.* rules (P0-3, A3.1). A token carries, as signed claims, the auth contract, the exact method id, the document snapshot digest, and the issuance lifecycle state and freshness references (auth.token.signed-claims). The token authorization scope is AUTHORIZATION_AT_ISSUANCE_WITH_MAX_AGE by default; CURRENT_AUTHORIZATION_AT_REQUEST is present only with a resource-server recheck (auth.token.issuance-vs-request, semantic constraint pinned by vector). A legacy token that lacks these claims MUST NOT be re-projected onto this shape (auth.token.no-legacy-reprojection). Wire field names are snake_case, the JWT/OAuth convention for this artifact family (these are JWT custom claims that sit alongside standard snake_case claims). $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

verification_method.$comment: auth.grant.exact-method: the absolute verification method id the grant used.

did_document_snapshot.$comment: auth.resolve.double-binding: the digest of the canonical document bytes actually used.

authorization_scope.$comment: claims.login.token-scopes: issuance-with-max-age by default; current-at-request only with a resource-server recheck.
